en: Salutation to the lotus-navelled one; salutation to you who lie on the waters. Salutation to you, Keshava, endless one; salutation to you, Vasudeva.
Again and again salutation to Krishna, Govinda, the God devoted to the holy, who does good to cows and Brahmins and to the whole world.
Just as rain falling from the sky goes to the ocean, so a salutation offered to any god goes to Keshava.

first: एष निष्कण्टकः पन्था यत्र संपूज्यते हरिः।
en: Where Hari is worshipped, that path is free of thorns. Know that any teaching without Govinda is a wrong path.
Whatever merit there is in all the Vedas, and whatever fruit in all the holy places, a person gains that fruit by praising God Janardana.

first: यो नरः पठते नित्यं त्रिकालं केशवालये।
en: A person who reads this daily in a temple of Keshava, three times, twice or once a day, removes everything harsh.

first: दह्यन्ते रिपवस्तस्य सौम्याः सर्वे सदा ग्रहाः।
en: When this hymn is recited, his enemies are burned up, all the planets are always kind to him, and his sins melt away.

first: येन ध्यातः श्रुतो येन येनायं पठ्यते स्तवः।
en: One who meditates on this hymn, hears it or reads it has, as it were, given every gift and worshipped all the gods.

first: इह लोके परे वापि न भयं विद्यते क्वचित्।
en: Whoever studies the thousand names on the twelfth day of the moon in my presence has no fear anywhere, in this world or the next.
Arjuna, sins of hundreds of millions of ages are slowly burned away when one sits near a holy fig tree with Keshava in the mind,
and reads the thousand names; one gains the merit of giving ten million cows. One who reads it daily in a temple of Shiva, sitting in a grove of tulasi,
gains liberation, as the holder of the discus has said. All terrible sins, even the killing of a Brahmin, are destroyed.

first: विलयं यान्ति पापानि चान्यपापस्य का कथा।
en: Such sins dissolve, so what need is there to speak of other sins? Freed from all sins, he goes to the world of Vishnu.
